about: Predictions for 2027 made in The Maestro Interlude (Nov 2026). Confidence is our judgement. 'check' is the date to score each prediction; 'wrong_if' says what would prove it wrong. Outcomes are filled in when checked.

items.claim: Every frontier lab ships its own agent platform (harness + builder + runtime) to enterprises
items.evidence: OpenAI, Google, Anthropic and Microsoft already ship coding agents and agent platforms (agentic series waves 1-4)
items.wrong_if: A frontier lab exits or spins out its agent platform

items.claim: Open-weight models reach parity with the best closed model on a major coding benchmark within 6 months of each closed release
items.evidence: Mistral Large 4, Qwen4-Max, Inkling 2 Small, Kimi K3.1 in Oct-Nov 2026 (Model Release Map)
items.wrong_if: The gap on the Benchmark Tracker widens two quarters in a row

items.claim: At least two more labs publish a self-improvement capability rating for a released model
items.evidence: GPT-6.2 Astra reported as rated High for AI self-improvement (Nov 2026)
items.wrong_if: No new self-improvement ratings in system cards by mid-2027

items.claim: Third-party evaluation becomes a routine purchase for EU general-purpose AI providers with systemic risk
items.evidence: EU AI Act GPAI obligations; external evaluators named in codes of practice
items.wrong_if: Obligations delayed or evaluations kept fully in-house

items.claim: Price per million tokens for frontier-class models falls at least 50% again by end of 2027
items.evidence: Cheaper tiers each quarter (Hydrogen, Sol, Haiku) and lower list prices (GPT-6.2)
items.wrong_if: List prices flat or rising across three labs

items.claim: Restricted-access models for cyber and bio become a standard product tier at three or more labs
items.evidence: Mythos 5.2, GPT-6 Cyber, Gemini 4 Carbon (Lab Updates)
items.wrong_if: Labs fold these back into general models

items.claim: Agent-to-agent purchasing (an agent buys a service from another company's agent) appears in a major platform's GA product
items.evidence: MCP, A2A and agent marketplaces (owner's notes on Rauch)
items.wrong_if: No GA agent-payment product by end 2027

items.claim: Most enterprise agent pilots still do not reach production in 2027 surveys
items.evidence: Forrester: ~88% of agent pilots never reach production; Gartner: 40% of agentic projects cancelled by 2027 (reported)
items.wrong_if: Major surveys report majority in production at scale

items.claim: A frontier lab acquires an evaluation, environment or agent-infrastructure start-up
Labs avoid on-premises deployment inside regulated customers' own data centres
items.evidence: Labs sell through clouds; on-prem goes via hyperscalers (AI Factory as a Service series)
items.wrong_if: A frontier lab ships its own on-prem appliance
